scope: Browse files and read local documents in Companion.

topics.title: File manager
details: File manager is the first main menu choice. It opens a drive list from Windows. It also lists mapped drives, registered cloud roots, Desktop, Documents, and Downloads.
Use arrows to move and Enter to open. Escape goes up one folder. Space marks items. Use Home and End for list ends. Say an item name or a normal list command.
Copy, cut, paste, rename, and delete work on files and folders. Delete asks first. Drives cannot be changed by those commands. Alt opens a menu with the voice phrases and keys.

topics.title: Read your files
details: Enter on a supported file opens it in Companion. The reader supports Word DOCX, text, HTML, PDF, ODT, and EPUB. It reads without changing the source file. Escape returns to the file list.

The reader does not run programs or web scripts. Legacy DOC and unknown file types are not opened. Scanned PDFs need OCR, which is not included. Password-protected files may need to be unlocked first.
Cloud files need their provider to make them available. Files have a 50 MB reading limit. The new guide and audio course explain each command.

topics.title: Know which dialog and task you are in
details: Options categories now say their full name and dialog. For example, Word processor options dialog.
Save Options to hear Options saved. You then hear where you are. For example, Main menu or Back to document.
